items.title: Show HN: Per Frame – film prices compared by cost per frame
items.contentSnippet:
I'm into film photography, and I built this tool to help me find the best price for a given type of film.
I'm currently tracking 185 films across formats (35mm, 120, 110, 4x5, Instax Mini, etc.) from 7 stores.
This is US only for now. If you shoot film I'd especially like to hear about stores I'm missing or anything that's wrong.

items.title: Show HN: Tell the Sky – message lanterns drift on winds from live weather data
items.contentSnippet:
I created a web/mobile app that lets you write a story/secret/encouragement/etc... on a lantern. You can then let it go and it will float over a world map using live wind data from NOAA's public wind forecast. Other users can then catch them in a timed window as they float by overhead and add on to the message chain. Then they release them to continue on.
